leadText: Pocket Monsters BW (Japanese: ポケットモンスターBW) is a shōnen Pokémon manga created by Kosaku Anakubo. It is a sequel to the Pokémon Pocket Monsters, Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire, and manga series and is succeeded by . The plot follows the adventures of and his Pokémon as they travel to the Unova region. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.
